svg.title: Remote control system on a Raspberry Pi 3
svg.desc: Four C++ processes as boxes: ClientNode on the PC, ServerNode as a router on the Pi, DigitalIONode for GPIO and EnvSensorNode with its UART loop. Commands such as relay 1:, temp:, key: and relay 0: travel along the wires as text, get routed by prefix, and the replies travel back.
